title: Acute and chronic effects of physical activity and exercise on glucose metrics in patients with type 1 diabetes. A retrospective analysis of the COCKPIT research data tiers
summary:
The aim of this retrospective analysis is to examine 1) the short-term effects of physical activity and exercise and 2) the long-term effects of weekly energy expenditure on glucose metrics derived from continuous glucose monitoring in people living with Type 1 diabetes who use the Diabetes Cockpit app.
The data are generated through the Diabetes Cockpit app and will subsequently be analyzed using statistical methods.

interventions.name: This study represents a retrospective data analysis of patient data of the digital Cockpit research data tiers.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
There will be no specified inclusion and exclusion criteria. Data is anonymized and analyzed depending on the statistical test, therefore the number of data points, i.e., patients included may vary. Inclusion and exclusion criteria may include (but are not limited to) age, number of workouts performed, number of kilocalories expended during a workout, type of workout, or duration of workout.
